assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I47.1.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment to characterize arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded with CPT 93271.
The cardiac event monitoring study directly supports the documented clinical indication for the paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia diagnosis.
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary.
The cardiac event monitoring study is not bundled into another covered procedure.
